feedback.finding: Reproducible Needle replay requires storing more than chosen tool: normalized-intent hash, preflight, selected toolset hash, runtime source/checkpoint/tokenizer identity, retrieval mode/candidates/scores, raw output hash, validator outcome/reasons, fallback path, confidence diagnostics and gold-set version.
feedback.recommended_delta: Persist these as typed receipt/event state with epochs. Do not turn retrieval scores or confidence into truth/authority fields.

feedback.finding: Needle experiments create useful causal/provenance edges: context_normalized->preflight, selected_candidate->Needle, runtime_identity->decision, validation->fallback/route, route->Clay ingress. These are diagnostic topology, not execution authority.
feedback.recommended_delta: Represent exact runtime/toolset/retrieval/fallback edges in H1/H2 run ClayGraphs for differential replay; keep graph activation non-authoritative.

feedback.finding: Validated Needle route is still pre-workspace proposal data. Rejected/no-tool/context-unresolved outcomes should be observable as routing/fallback traces so later GWT uptake can distinguish Needle success from 4B fallback, but Needle confidence does not become workspace truth.
Retriever choice, top-k, description policy, alias policy and confidence surface remain competing alternatives. Preserve them until matched-budget official-checkpoint experiments collapse the set.
No emergence or consciousness claim follows from Needle routing, confidence, retrieval, recurrence or single-shot fallback behavior.

The Clay-native target remains fixed with Needle as the sole intentional semantic foreign body. This run narrows the safe conversion boundary without promoting Needle into Clay cognition or execution authority.

global_negative_results_preserved: Constrained decoding is not an authority/security proof in either inspected Python or Cactus Needle path.
No-tool is not trained/evaluated by Needle contrastive retrieval and is not protected by stock finetune best-checkpoint selection.
The historical full-51 contrastive-rationale against inference-time top-k was overstated by the actual training code.
Unicode-aware BM25 alone showed only modest gain in a small lexical diagnostic; do not overpromote it.
Names-only tool text sharply degraded the same lexical diagnostic; descriptions carry real signal.
A default generic confidence threshold is not calibrated Frank/Needle correctness evidence.
Official model size is not the current sandbox blocker; missing mounted binary artifacts are.
